source.paper: Yingying He et al., Uncertainty-Guided Decision-Making in Bumble Bees (2026-09-22 bioRxiv preprint)
source.license_note: External raw observations are not republished by adaptive-gain.

trial_order_balance.interpretation: The free-cue condition appears spread across trial order; this diagnostic does not establish assignment randomization.

descriptive_free_minus_regular_landing_s.interpretation: Coarse trial-order stratification retains sign of the cross-condition landing contrast; no causal interpretation is licensed.

bee_level_exploration.method: Per-bee mean Regular-trial request-platform landing propensity in active-info experiment versus per-bee mean latency in separate metacognition timing experiment at same difficulty; Pearson r; bee-label shuffle two-sided permutation B=5000, xorshift32 seed 0x229184; exploratory, three uncorrected contrasts
bee_level_exploration.warning: The individual-level exploratory correlations do not identify how requesting fresh information changes the latency of the same decision; failure to reject does not establish zero effect.

claim_ceiling: Numeric identifiers reused across behavioral experiments cannot be used to assign Decision_Latency_ms to an active information request. The mismatch in difficulty directly disproves common event identity in 12399 nominally matched records. A same-trial timing effect cannot be estimated from these two files.
recommended_next_step: Use only within-experiment trial records for action outcomes; request synchronized decision/request timestamps or run a new PASSIVE/SHAM/INFORMATIVE experiment logging state transitions, query choice, post-query wait, terminal latency and actual reward in the same encounter.
